verdict.rationale: three.js is itself a code-first library, so its documented JavaScript API lets an agent create scenes and objects and set properties programmatically, and the probe confirms coding agents drive the library directly through npm. There is no evidence of a scriptable interface for the three.js editor or of project/build automation. missing for 10: documented programmatic control of the three.js editor, build/export triggering interface, agent-oriented automation API (no MCP exists), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive the editor and project programmatically — create scenes and nodes, edit properties, trigger builds — through a documented scriptable interface

citations.quote: This code creates a scene, a camera, and a geometric cube, and it adds the cube to the scene.
